source_text: Si venerimus in Issachar — id est si mandata Domini servemus — Deus conteret Satanam sub pedibus, et dabitur potestas calcandi serpentes et scorpiones. Cui gloria et imperium in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: If we-will-have-come into Issachar — that is if commands of-Lord we-keep — God will-crush Satan under feet, and will-be-given power of-treading serpents and scorpions. To-whom glory and dominion into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: If we come into Jeshurun — that is, if we keep the Lord’s commands — [[God will crush Satan under your feet >> Bible:Romans 16:20]], and we receive [[power to tread on serpents and scorpions >> Bible:Luke 10:19]]. To whom be glory and dominion forever. Amen.
